title: primula frondosa subsp. exigua
intro: Primula frondosa subsp. exigua, commonly known as Alpine primrose, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Primulaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Primula frondosa subsp. exigua are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
